title: Rooms
subtitle: Discussions between several models, with you in control.
engineUnavailable: Discussion rooms are not available in this build.
notFound: This room could not be found.

list.emptyHint: Create a room, add at least two participants, and start the discussion.
list.noPreview: Open the room to see the discussion.

create.title: New room
create.description: Give the room a title and an objective. You can add participants next.
create.objectivePlaceholder: What should the participants discuss or decide?

delete.title: Delete room?
delete.description: “{{title}}” and its whole transcript will be removed. This cannot be undone.

mode.round-robinHint: Participants speak in order; a round ends when everyone has spoken.
mode.user-selectedHint: After each turn the room waits for you to pick the next speaker.
mode.moderator-selectedHint: A moderator model picks each speaker and can close the discussion.
mode.compareHint: Each message goes to every participant at once; they answer on their own, without seeing each other, side by side.

clear.command: Clear this room: its chat, what it learned, its scratch files
clear.title: Clear this room
clear.description: Choose what to forget. This cannot be undone.
clear.running: Pause or stop the room first: a running room cannot be cleared.
clear.chatHint: Every message, vote and synthesis. The room goes back to a draft.
clear.knowledgeHint: Also what the room built up from the chat: run counters and limits used, the round it was in, and any suspended participant. It starts over from the objective.
clear.everythingHint: Also the room's scratch files and command sandbox, and any approval still waiting for an answer.
clear.kept: The room's settings, participants and limits, and the folders attached to it, are never touched.

editor.heading: Room settings
editor.lockedWhileRunning: Pause the room to change settings.
editor.title: Title
editor.workingFolderHint: Participants with tool access read files from this folder.
editor.participantsHint: At least two participants are needed to start. Up to {{max}}.
editor.toolReadHint: Read-only tools only. Approvals never apply in rooms: anything that needs approval is refused. MCP tools appear only for servers you've already trusted in Settings.
editor.toolFullHint: Everything a Cowork session can do: read, write, run commands, git, skills and plugins, in the room's folders. As in Cowork, a call that changes something or runs a command waits for you to allow it (see the approvals in the header), using your saved rules. More steps per turn. Needs a folder and a tool-capable model.
editor.toolEditHint: Reads plus write/edit, confined to the room's working folder. Attach a folder for these tools to work. MCP tools appear only for servers you've already trusted in Settings.
editor.toolUnsupported: This model does not support tools, so tool access stays off.
editor.thinkingBudgetHint: A share of the model's context, worked out when the turn is sent and capped so the reply still fits.
editor.pricingHint: Used only for the cost limit.
editor.maxReached: This room already has the maximum of {{max}} participants.
editor.limitsHint: Every limit is capped by a fixed ceiling.
editor.costHint: The cost limit works only when every model that speaks has pricing. Without it, cost is not tracked.
editor.costMissingPricing: Some models have no pricing, so the cost limit will not be enforced.

errors.nameModerator: The moderator already uses this name.
errors.moderatorModelRequired: Choose a model for the moderator.
errors.moderatorRequired: Moderator-chosen mode needs an enabled moderator.

editor.compareRunHint: One at a time is slower, but loads one local model at a time and spares rate limits.
editor.compareRunSuggest: Two or more local models are selected: running them one at a time keeps them from competing for memory.

tools.heading: Tools
tools.empty: No tools are available with this access.
tools.share: Tool definitions use about {{pct}}% of this model's context window.
tools.warn: Tool definitions use about {{pct}}% of this model's context window (over {{limit}}%). Switch some off to leave room for the discussion.
tools.windowUnknown: This model's context window is not known, so the share cannot be shown.

budget.heading: Tool budget per turn
budget.hint: Caps for each participant turn that uses tools. Leave a field empty for the default.

isolation.active: Each participant that can edit works in its own isolated workspace, so they cannot overwrite each other or your folder.
isolation.unavailable: Isolated workspace unavailable: {{reason}}. Participants that can edit only read in this room.

model.noProviders: No models available. Add a provider in Settings.

transcript.label: Discussion transcript
transcript.compactingBody: Summarising earlier messages that no longer fit the context window…
transcript.speedTitle: Tokens written in this reply, and how fast

budgetHit.tool-calls: This turn reached its tool call budget.
budgetHit.steps: This turn reached its step budget.
budgetHit.timeout: A tool call in this turn ran past the tool timeout and was stopped.

transcript.rawToolCall: This looks like a tool call written as text. It was not run.

emptyReply.length: The model used its whole reply limit ({{count}} tokens) without writing an answer. Raise the reply limit in the room settings, or turn this participant's reasoning off, then run again.
emptyReply.tools: Used tools, but wrote no text reply.

transcript.expandAnswer: Show all of the answer from {{name}}
transcript.linkScrollHint: Scroll the answers to one question together
transcript.continuePrompt: Continue your previous answer from where it was cut off.
transcript.catchUpHint: This participant joined after these questions, so this reply answers them as well:

unknownWindow.title: Context window unknown
unknownWindow.description: {{subject}} uses models whose context window Flint can't determine. Set Max Context Tokens for each, or use the safe default of {{window}} tokens, which keeps long discussions compacting early.

controls.label: Room controls
controls.stopDescription: The current turn is aborted and the room stops. You can start it again later.
controls.needParticipants: Add at least two participants to start.
controls.finalPositionsHint: Each participant states where they stand
controls.synthesizeHint: Summary of the outcome, with dissent
controls.cancelTurnHint: Stop only the reply in progress
controls.steerLocked: These unlock once the discussion is running.

stage.runningHint: The next speaker is getting ready.
stage.awaitingHint: Pick who speaks next, or write to the room.
stage.comparingHint: Each answers on its own; the answers appear side by side.
stage.compareAwaitingHint: Write a message and every participant answers it.
stage.stoppedHint: Start again to continue from here.
stage.question: Question

composer.label: Message to the room
composer.placeholder: Write to the room… use @ to mention someone
composer.placeholderExtend: Add a message for the participants (optional)…
composer.limitReached: The {{limit}} limit was reached. Continue the discussion?
composer.dropSkipped: Not added (not text, a folder, or past the message limit): {{files}}

review.name: Architecture review
review.hint: Weigh a design decision from several angles before you commit.
review.objective: Review the proposed design, surface the risks, and agree on the safest approach.

naming.name: Naming
naming.hint: Short, memorable names, argued over and shortlisted.
naming.objective: Propose short, memorable names, then agree on a shortlist of three.

crosscheck.name: Cross-check
crosscheck.hint: Several models verify the same facts independently.
crosscheck.objective: Check the same facts independently and report where the answers disagree.

debate.name: Debate
debate.hint: Two sides argue it out, then you call the vote.
debate.objective: Argue for and against the proposal, then state final positions.

compare.title: Compare runs
compare.runAgainFor: Run {{name}} again on the current question
compare.answerEarlierHint: Every model that missed an earlier question answers it now, in order, as if it had been there.
compare.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

state.off: Left out of the next run
state.waitingSlot: Queued: waiting for the local model slot

changes.diffHint: Everything this participant changed in its isolated workspace.
changes.discardHint: The participant's workspace goes back to how it started. Your folder is not touched.
changes.applyIncludesEarlier_one: Apply also includes {{count}} earlier file not applied yet
changes.applyIncludesEarlier_other: Apply also includes {{count}} earlier files not applied yet

apply.safety: Nothing is applied if the patch does not apply cleanly. You can undo right after.
apply.checking: Checking whether it applies to your folder…
apply.conflict_one: {{count}} file does not apply to your folder
apply.conflict_other: {{count}} files do not apply to your folder
apply.conflictHint: Leave them out, or ask the participant to redo them against your folder as it is now.
apply.notChecked: not checked on its own (too many files)
apply.dirtyTitle_one: You have uncommitted changes in {{count}} of these files
apply.dirtyTitle_other: You have uncommitted changes in {{count}} of these files
apply.dirtyHint: The patch is written on top of your edits. Commit or stash first if you want an easy way back.
apply.binary: Binary file changed. Its content is not shown.
apply.noLines: No line changes (mode or name only).
apply.blockedConflict: Apply is off: some selected files do not apply cleanly.
apply.blockedNothing: Select at least one file to apply.
apply.blockedFailed: Apply is off until the check succeeds.
apply.undone: The change was taken back out of your folder

approvals.heldHint: The room was paused while this was waiting, so it can no longer be allowed. Resume the room and the participant will ask again if it still needs it.
approvals.heldBanner: Room paused: this request can no longer be allowed. Resume to ask again.
